---
title: Comment attached to a code block
format: docx
---

Quarto's document-profile comment extraction treats a
`.quarto-edit-comment-container` div wrapping a code block plus a trailing
`[>> ... ]` mark as "one comment about that code", rather than the comment
being a comment-about-itself. Word/PowerPoint have no native concept of a
comment anchored to a fenced code block, so this is one of the harder
mappings for the OOXML filter to get right — most likely the code block's
rendered text becomes the Word comment's anchor range.

::: {.quarto-edit-comment-container}

```python
x = 1
```

For contrast, a plain block comment not attached to any code:

::: >>

This paragraph is itself the anchor and the comment; there is no separate
target content.

:::

And an inline comment nested inside a block comment — per
`document_profile.rs`, this nested inline mark is folded into the *outer*
comment's text rather than producing a second, separate comment:

::: >>

Outer [>> inner ] text.
